Screen Room at Rio Cinema offers a unique experience for event organisers, providing a blend of mainstream features, kids' films, and arthouse movies in an East London art deco cinema setting. The space is ideal for hosting film screenings, private screenings, film festivals, and themed events. With a historic ambiance and independent charm, Screen Room caters to a diverse range of event types, creating a memorable atmosphere for attendees.

## About this space

The Rio Cinema is a 100 year old art deco picture house located in Dalston , Hackney, East London. The auditorium has both stalls and circle seating with a capacity of 400 people. There is a stunning large screen which allows for both digital and traditional 35mm projection. A stage makes the auditorium suitable for presentations and conferences. There is a foyer and licensed bar area. Excellent for conferences and corporate presentations .
